approved_overrides.notes: Unmodified export of the approved three-layer composition using the current Figma frame's lavender fill. Original production snapshot retained.

Home card for the rewards case study (Carbon and Branch): option C, revision 3, “Earned, not given”, chosen by the owner on 6 November 2026. Artwork made with the built-in ImageGen tool, using the Carbon and Branch case-study assets as reference (prompts in the Reviews folder's PROMPTS.json); the enamel tier badges are artistic reinterpretations of Carbon's tier colours and hexagon shape, not Figma renders. ₦1,250 is the case study's sample balance, not a business result; Carbon's six tiers and Branch's 2% cashback are real. Web file: sRGB progressive JPEG at quality 88, copied unchanged from the 4.4 MB PNG master's export. The alt text starts with “Generated”, so the share image carries the generated cover note.

Home card for “Building Branch’s AI UX Writing System”: option B, revision 7, “The writing guide”, chosen by the owner on 6 November 2026. A navy guide labelled Branch UX Writing System with Brand, Context and Components tabs, illustrating the reusable writing skill; it doesn't claim a physical book was made. The book and scene are ImageGen artwork (prompts in the Reviews folder's PROMPTS.json); the cover title and tab labels are typeset in code and projected onto the cover and tabs (book-title-v7.js, perspective-text.js). No invented metrics. Web file: sRGB progressive JPEG at quality 88, copied unchanged from the 3.6 MB PNG master's export. Replaces the recreated CopyGPT review thumbnail, removed from public/work/ai-copywriting/. The alt text starts with “Generated”, so the share image carries the generated cover note.

Home card for the Agile AI-driven design case study: the owner's generated cover of a stitched notebook titled AGENTS.md, with “Design judgment, written for agents” and “judgment” underlined in blue, on deep blue cloth, sent on 18 November 2026. The original (source/Agent_MD_Thumbnsil.png in the Reviews folder) is 1536 by 1024 (3:2); Cowork's make-16x9.py extended it to 16:9 by building only the blue margins, leaving the notebook's pixels untouched, so the card doesn't crop the notebook. Web file: progressive JPEG at quality 86, copied unchanged from the export. The case-study page keeps its device hero (hero-pixel.webp). The alt text starts with “Generated”, so the share image carries the generated cover note.

Home card for the Helium case study: the owner's generated cover, “Helium v.2 Design System” above a cream tile with a purple pen tool, joined like a puzzle piece to a dark tile with a selected Button tag, on lavender, sent on 18 November 2026 and copied byte for byte from the Reviews source (there is no separate master).
